data.title: Sporting Braga vs Gent Prediction & Betting Tip | 22 Oct 2026
data.content:
Well, I go with Braga cause this coaching change is very important, same with the fact that Braga have no injury/suspension problems at all. Also, Gent suffered a considerable psychological setback. On Sunday, they were eliminated from the Belgian Cup by third-division Union Rochefortoise (3:3, extra time, lost on penalties).

However, Gent are still a difficult opponent! Good luck! [...] Franclim Carvalho was appointed as the new coach on Tuesday and this will be his first game on the bench. He knows the club very well, as he previously worked as an assistant to Artur Jorge, and will try to bring back the confidence and passion that Braga have been missing recently.

Defender Sikou Niakaté (0/0) is still out with a long-term injury, while there are no other important squad problems reported. [...] Although Gent were leading 1:3 in the second half, they allowed the hosts to equalise and eventually lost on penalties after 120 minutes. Surely a disappointing result that affected their morale, while they also have a very important league game against Anderlecht next Sunday.

Forward Josué Vergara (7/3) and defender Mouhamed Ngom (5/0) are injured, while forward Max Dean (1/0) is not registered for the European competition.
